Aggregate.description: An aggregate over the rows matching `filters`, tagged by `op`.

AttributeSchema.description: Type and indexing of one attribute.

embed.description:
Embed a `string` attribute into the vector of rows written without
one, with the server's embedding model. One attribute per
namespace. Default `false`.

full_text_search.description:
Index a `string` attribute for `BM25` ranking. Applies to rows
written after it is enabled. Default `false`.

dimensions.description:
Vector length, 1 to 65535. Every row's vector must have it.
Optional when an attribute embeds: the embedding model's length.

schema.description:
Attributes to declare up front. Undeclared attributes are typed from
the first value written.

DistanceMetric.description: How vector distance is measured. Fixed when the namespace is created.

Document.description: A document stored as one row per passage.

attributes.description: Attributes copied onto every passage row.

id.description:
Document id: a string or non-negative integer. Passage `i` is
stored as row `"{id}#{i}"`.

passages.description:
Passages in order, each `{"vector": [..], attribute: value, ..}`.
Passage attributes override document attributes.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Error body of every 4xx and 5xx response.

Filter.description:
A boolean filter over row attributes, tagged by `op`. On array
attributes, operators match when any element does; negated operators
also match rows without the attribute. See
[filters](/vector/queries/#filters).

FilterContains.description: An array attribute has the value as an element.

FilterContainsAny.description: An array attribute has any of the values as an element.

FilterEq.description: An attribute compared with one value.

FilterGt.description: An attribute compared with one value.

FilterGte.description: An attribute compared with one value.

FilterLt.description: An attribute compared with one value.

FilterLte.description: An attribute compared with one value.

FilterNotContains.description: An attribute compared with one value.

FilterNotContainsAny.description: An attribute compared with a set of values.

FilterNotEq.description: An attribute compared with one value.

FilterNotExists.description: The row doesn't have the attribute.

FilterNotGlob.description:
A `string` attribute matched against a glob pattern: `*`, `?`,
classes like `[a-z]` and `[!0-9]`, and `\` to escape.

FilterNotIGlob.description:
A `string` attribute matched against a glob pattern: `*`, `?`,
classes like `[a-z]` and `[!0-9]`, and `\` to escape.

FilterNotIn.description: An attribute compared with a set of values.

FilterValue.description:
A filter operand: one value of the attribute's type, or of its element
type for array attributes.

embedding_model.description:
The model embedding the namespace, e.g.
`openai:text-embedding-3-small`, fixed when an attribute first
embeds.

id.description: Hex key prefix of the namespace inside its shard.

schema.description: Every known attribute, declared or inferred.

NamespaceRange.description: Namespace ids `[start, end)`, as 16 hex digits.

end.description: Absent when the range extends to the end of the id space.

PerLimit.description: At most `limit` rows per distinct combination of `attributes`.

attributes.description: Attributes to group by, e.g. `["$doc_id"]`. `id` is allowed.

Query.description: A query, or a batch of queries when `queries` is set.

aggregate_by.description:
Named aggregates over every row matching `filters`, e.g.
`{"total": {"op": "Count"}}`. Without `rank_by`, the response
has no rows.

include_attributes.description:
`true` (every attribute except `vector`, the default), `false`
(only `id` and the score), or a list of names; list `vector`
to return it.

limit.description:
A row count (default `10`), or `{"total": n, "per": {..}}` to
cap rows per group, e.g. passages per document.

nprobe.description:
ANN centroids to probe. Default `limit` clamped to 10–100;
filtered queries that come up short are retried with more.

queries.description:
Multi-query: run these queries against one snapshot. Only
`consistency` and `rrf` may accompany it.

oneOf.description: How to order rows. Default: ascending `id`.

Multi-query: fuse the results into one ranking by reciprocal rank
fusion. Without it, each query's result is returned in `results`.

results.description: Multi-query without `rrf`: one result per query, in order.

rows.description:
Matching rows, best first: `id`, then `$dist` (vector ranking) or
`$score` (BM25 and RRF), then the selected attributes. Absent for
aggregation-only queries.

RankBy.description:
How to order rows, tagged by `op`. See
[ranking](/vector/queries/#ranking).

RankByANN.description: Approximate nearest neighbours, closest first. Adds `$dist`.

text.description:
Text to embed into the query vector, in a namespace with an
`embed` attribute.

vector.description:
The query vector, with the namespace's dimensions. Exactly one of
`vector` and `text`.

RankByKNN.description:
Exact nearest neighbours of the rows matching the filter. Adds
`$dist`.

text.description:
Text to embed into the query vector, in a namespace with an
`embed` attribute.

vector.description:
The query vector, with the namespace's dimensions. Exactly one of
`vector` and `text`.

attribute.description:
An attribute, or `id` (ascending only). Rows without the attribute
come last.

Row.description: A row with every attribute, including `vector`.

k.description:
Rank offset: a row at rank `r` (from 1) adds `1 / (k + r)` to its
fused score. Default `60`.

limit.description: Fused rows to return. Defaults to the largest sub-query limit.

SchemaUpdate.description: Schema entries to add or update, by attribute name.

children.description: Shards this one was split into.

owner.description:
Writer replica that owns the shard: each writer owns one active
shard.

parent.description: Shard this one was split from.

range.description:
Namespace ids the shard holds; every id belongs to exactly one
active shard.

split_to.description:
A writer that joined without a shard: the owner is splitting this
shard and hands it the upper half.

SubQuery.description: One query of a multi-query batch.

aggregate_by.description:
Named aggregates over every row matching `filters`, e.g.
`{"total": {"op": "Count"}}`. Without `rank_by`, the response
has no rows.

include_attributes.description:
`true` (every attribute except `vector`, the default), `false`
(only `id` and the score), or a list of names; list `vector`
to return it.

limit.description:
A row count (default `10`), or `{"total": n, "per": {..}}` to
cap rows per group, e.g. passages per document.

nprobe.description:
ANN centroids to probe. Default `limit` clamped to 10–100;
filtered queries that come up short are retried with more.

oneOf.description: How to order rows. Default: ascending `id`.

SubQueryResult.description: The result of one query of a batch.

Write.description:
Changes to one namespace. Writing to a missing namespace creates it,
taking its dimensions from the first vector in the request, or from the
embedding model when `schema` declares an `embed` attribute. Rows of a
namespace with an `embed` attribute may omit `vector`.

Operations apply in the order `delete_by_filter`, `delete_documents`,
`upsert_documents`, `upsert_rows`, `patch_rows`, `deletes`. The request
is validated before anything is applied; each operation is atomic, the
request as a whole is not.

oneOf.description: Deletes every row matching this filter.

delete_documents.description: Ids of documents whose passages to delete.

oneOf.description:
Metric of a namespace this write creates. Must match an existing
namespace's metric.

patch_rows.description:
Partial rows merged into existing rows by `id`. `null` removes an
attribute; rows that don't exist are skipped.

schema.description: Schema entries applied before the write, as in `PATCH .../schema`.

upsert_documents.description:
Documents to insert or replace. A document's previous passages are
replaced, including any beyond the new passage count.

upsert_rows.description:
Rows to insert or replace: `{"id": .., "vector": [..], attribute:
value, ..}`. `null` attributes are omitted.

rows_deleted.description:
Rows removed by `deletes`, `delete_by_filter`, `delete_documents`,
and stale passages of upserted documents.

info.description:
Namespaced vector search with attribute filters, full-text ranking, multi-passage documents, and shard inspection.

When authentication is configured, requests carry Basic credentials or a JWT bearer token. Namespace credentials grant read (queries, rows, metadata) or write (also creating, configuring, deleting and writing to the namespace) access to one namespace; global credentials cover every namespace and the shard listing. Namespaces must be declared, for example by a NamespaceAuthentication resource, and others answer 404. Listings show only the namespaces the caller can read.
